title: switch

lines.explanation:
switch statement allows to implement selection. It has a selection variable ('springMonth' in our case) and it 
compares it against the possible cases until it finds a 
matching case.

The 'case' clause compares springMonth with a value. Here 'case' compares with 1. If the value of 
'springMonth' is 1, two things happen: the program 
prints "March" and then it leaves the switch statement 
(this is what 'break' is for)

If the value of 'springMonth' is 2, the program prints "April" and leaves the switch statement. This is what 
happens in this program.

If the value of 'springMonth' is 3 the program prints "May" and leaves the switch statement.In our case the 
program  will never get to this point, since it'll leave 
switch statement in the previous case.

if the selection variable matches none of the cases it will match the 'default' case and execute the code 
after 'default'.'default' can be omitted -in this case 
nothing happens for the unmatched cases.
